portal_description:
The libvirt-glib packages provide integration between the libvirt library and the glib event loop.

The libvirt-glib packages have been upgraded to upstream version 0.1.9, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version. Notably, the update adds API support for further guest domain configuration options and guest snapshot management. (BZ#1174554)

Users of libvirt-glib are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and add these enhancements.
